reason: The operator journey is substantially more coherent: authorized cohort context persists, staffing and submitted forms are distinguished from canonical valid evidence, incomplete Group Case work remains visible, irreversible closure explains unfinished work, and ambiguous closure/release outcomes avoid immediate replay. The 500-outcome review preserves its complete snapshot while filtering; specific diagnostics now identify blocked rounds and distinguish open collection from closed-round escalation. However, offer-deadline editing retains an unbounded pending path, inconsistent with the otherwise careful consequential-write recovery. Together with absent approved project proof, workload facts, Board remediation authority and hosted acceptance, this does not meet the unchanged broad world-class standard. Hold a consequential recruitment rollout pending the control fix and actual integrated acceptance; local test success alone does not establish that rollout.

findings.userImpact: A stalled request can strand an operator while changing an applicant response deadline, with no in-place recovery or confirmation of whether the deadline changed.
findings.suggestedFix: Bound the full request/body wait, restore controls with explicit unknown-outcome guidance, and reconcile the stored deadline before another change. Add focused stalled-response and committed-write/lost-acknowledgement checks for this actual control.
